title: Hi
body:
Hi reader i suppose youve been on my website and seen this blog. I just have it here to... put stuff in to yknow just talk about stuff i wanna talk about i suppose.
I'm atomicdude (if ya didn't know already) and well im just sitting here in a hotel lodge in the middle of somewhere after a nice coffee... writing a blog post thinking about who's gonna see it but yeah this is really my first proper way of cummuincating with you, the netizen visiting my site! So yeah have a good time on my website and have a good day

title: Site update
body:
Ok so sometime soon (not sure when but ... soon) theres gonna be some nice changes to the site im planning to:

Add a winamp music player. so you can listen to music

Add a project library. this is a place where i can upload programs and files for all the projects i do and yall can try them out and stuff

Add picture support to the blog. see currently im using a python program i made to write my blog posts which makes editiing and writing much easier and quicker and that doesnt have picture support yet so ill have to add that.

In other news i made a cool mini strandbeest it took about 5 hours of 3d printing and about a half hour of fiddling with linkages and other stuff to get it assembled but yeah now i have a strandbeest!

I hope you have a good day and a good rest of your week and thanks again for visiting my neocities! :)
